evidence_note: This cross-check uses a public extraction of OnePlus 13 stock proprietary vendor files. It is not first-party source code and is kept separate from the official-source catalog.
stock_routing_observations: dodgetele2 is used by stock tele photo modes.
dodgetele2 is used by SAT tele, fast-motion tele, portrait 3x/3.7x, night, Hi-RES and XPAN entries.
stock RAW full-size tables include both dodgetele and dodgetele2 naming.
stock config contains logical ultraTele/utele terminology and VigTab_UTele assets.
logical tele1/tele2/ultratele naming therefore cannot be equated directly with extra physical lenses.

stock_hybridraw_baseline.conclusion: OnePlus 13 stock already ships the Stable-Diffusion-style HybridRAW/high-zoom model family. The addon replaces/extends an existing family rather than introducing the capability from zero.

corrected_policy.tele2: Do not classify tele2-named files as donor-only. Stock OnePlus 13 routes its active telephoto through dodgetele2 in many modes.
corrected_policy.six_x: Treat 6x as a zoom/model operating region until a physical-lens mapping proves otherwise.
corrected_policy.utele: Treat utele/UltraTele as unresolved logical high-zoom nomenclature; stock itself contains UTele terminology.
corrected_policy.camera4: Do not synthesize an additional physical camera from a Camera4/logical slot name without engineering-mode/HAL evidence.
corrected_policy.deletion: No tele2/6x/utele asset is safe-to-delete solely from its name.
